address: 199-205 Soi Charoen Rat 1, Khlong San, Bangkok, 10600, Thailand
bio: This cart serves some of the best steamed crabs or prawns on glass noodles at wallet-friendly prices. Make sure you stir the noodles to soak up the tasty juices. It has a few branches, but this is where it all started. Come early or the wait will be long....
